in_sanskrit.name: ब्रह्मगी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhrigu is a sage and the son of Lord Brahma, the Hindu god of creation. He is the god of priesthood and the giver of knowledge and wisdom. He is also known as the father of Jatya, the progenitor of the human race.

in_hindi.name: ब्रह्रुगु
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bhrigu is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Brahman', which refers to the supreme spiritual reality and the ultimate source of all existence in Hinduism. It is also the name of a sage and the son of Lord Brahma.

in_tamil.name: பிரகு
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bhrigu is a Tamil name meaning 'scholar' or 'wise person'. It is also the name of a sage and the son of Lord Brahma in Hindu mythology.

in_telugu.name: బ్రహ్జు
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bhrigu is a Telugu name meaning 'Lord of Brahma'. It is also the name of a sage and the son of Lord Brahma in Hindu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Bhrigu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Astronomy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhrigu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhrigu is a revered sage in Hindu mythology, the founder of Jyotish (Astrology). He is considered the god of astronomy and prayer. The name is derived from the Sanskrit root ‘bhr’ meaning 'to grow'.
